How? Maybe SPACE toggles the "pour direction," or maybe the arrow keys move the contents of the container? But UP/DOWN did nothing...
Hmm, wait, maybe UP/DOWN move the contents of the container, but only when the container is "selected"? Or maybe MOUSE is needed to select the container first.

Let me reconsider the legend: the upper left shows a white 10x5 on top of a purple 10x5. Maybe the legend is just a color key showing the two colors (white and purple) used in this level, not the goal arrangement.
Then the goal is: fill the white container completely with purple? The first SPACE filled 5 rows. Why didn't the second SPACE fill more?
Maybe SPACE pours all the remaining purple from the frame into the container, but only if the frame is directly above the container and aligned? After the first SPACE, the frame is still directly above the container. Hmm.
Or maybe SPACE pours 5 rows per press, but the pour is limited by the amount of purple in the frame... the frame still has 84px of purple.
Let me try SPACE again now (the frame is axis-aligned, above the container) and see if more gets filled.
